facts.fact: The CMIL's procedures manual (initial version following its deliberation of 17 October 2025) states that it turns the obligations of Loi n°2014-038 of 9 January 2015 on the protection of personal data and its implementing texts into practical procedures, treating the law as the operative legal basis.
facts.system: Loi n°2014-038 du 9 janvier 2015 relative à la protection des données à caractère personnel

facts.fact: The manual sets the CMIL's procedures for declarations, authorisations, audits, complaints (acknowledgement in 48 hours, decision within 30 working days) and administrative sanctions, but states no decision, sanction or count of cases under the law; the document is dated by its publication on 3 December 2025.
facts.system: Loi n°2014-038 du 9 janvier 2015 relative à la protection des données à caractère personnel

facts.fact: The manual describes the CMIL as an independent administrative authority whose Collège members are appointed by decree in the Council of Ministers under article 29 of the law, and its annexed minutes template records a session of 14 August 2025 with all eight sitting members named present.
